text:
If your plans involve being outside today, morning's your best window, before the sky starts thinking about mischief. Mostly sunny early with a high near 81, and NWS keeps the shower chance modest at 30 percent this afternoon into evening. Worth knowing the European model isn't buying that quiet read at all, it's got a much wetter day in mind, so if you've got outdoor plans stretching into afternoon, keep the rain jacket within reach even under blue sky. Humidity's up there but the air itself is clean and good today.

The lake's calm and inviting this morning, light winds, waves a foot or two, water sitting at a comfortable 76. That's your window for paddling or a swim before clouds and shower chances build. Thunderstorm chances tick higher tonight into Thursday as a wave moves through, and Thursday night looks like the wetter, louder one of the two, showers and storms likely before 7. I'd plan today's outdoor stretch for before 2pm and treat any afternoon plans as rain-jacket-optional, lean-toward-yes.
